quarterly_data.quarter: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (07-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments H1 FY2026. Chemicals: acrylic ester sales for automotive and other coatings and for optical and other adhesives were flat, sales for inks including UV inkjet decreased, and methacrylic ester sales were weak; sales JPY 6,680 million (+2.4%), segment profit JPY 1,274 million (+26.9%) on improved production efficiency. Functional Chemicals: cosmetic material sales were strong, functional material sales rose sharply and the subsidiary's high-purity specialty solvents sold well; sales JPY 3,668 million (+20.0%), segment profit JPY 990 million (+60.4%).
